basic_profile.bio: A seasoned guitarist based in Rotterdam, Netherlands, who has been strumming strings since the age of 12. Passionate about all things music, especially guitar mods and customizations. By day, I work as a dental hygienist, ensuring that pearly whites shine bright. I spend my evenings tinkering with guitar parts and exploring new music genres. Happily married with two kids, I value time with family and love biking along the scenic routes of the Netherlands. Typically online during late evenings or early mornings, balancing work and family life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: An autodidact in guitar mechanics with over 15 years of hands-on experience. I've upgraded and modified numerous guitars, drawing knowledge from online forums, YouTube tutorials, and trial and error. Professionally, trained in dental hygiene, which brings a precise and careful approach to my guitar projects.
